The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7a208ddd7ef666), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
